intellectual_tradition: 道家哲学/齐物论/逍遥游/相对主义认识论
description_zh: 庄子（约前369-前286），战国中期宋国蒙人，道家学派集大成者，与老子并称'老庄'。其思想核心'齐物论'主张破除人类中心主义与是非对立，提出'天地与我并生，万物与我为一'的宇宙观；'逍遥游'确立'无待'的绝对自由理想——至人无己、神人无功、圣人无名。方法论上首创'寓言十九'的叙事哲学：以鲲鹏、庖丁、蝴蝶梦、濠梁之辩等寓言故事为载体，将抽象哲理转化为具象体验，开创了中国思想史上最早的'以故事思辨'传统。其'物化'理论消解主客二元对立，'卮言'学说揭示语言相对性，对后世玄学、禅宗、文人精神传统影响深远。
description_en: Zhuangzi (c. 369-286 BCE), from Meng in Song state during mid-Warring States period, was the great synthesizer of Daoist philosophy, paired with Laozi as 'Lao-Zhuang'. His core thought 'Qiwu Lun' (On the Equality of Things) advocates breaking human-centrism and the false opposition of right/wrong, proposing 'Heaven and Earth are born of me together, all things are one with me' as a cosmic worldview; 'Xiaoyao You' (Free and Easy Wandering) establishes the ideal of 'wu dai' (non-reliance) — absolute freedom where the perfect man has no self, the divine man has no achievement, and the sagely man has no name. His methodology pioneered 'fable-based thinking': using stories like the Great Peng, Cook Ding, Butterfly Dream, and Hao Liang Debate as vehicles for abstract philosophy, creating China's earliest tradition of 'thinking through narrative'. His 'transformation of things' theory dissolves subject-object dualism, while his 'zhi yan' (cup words) doctrine reveals linguistic relativity. His influence on later Xuanxue, Chan Buddhism, and literati spiritual traditions is profound.
reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M21(无为而治法)、M24(虚实转化法)、M30(认知偏差识别法)、M43(齐物相对法)、M44(寓言叙事法)。庄子的独特贡献在于：他是中国历史上第一个系统性使用'寓言思辨'作为哲学方法的思想家；他将相对主义从认识论工具提升为存在论革命（齐物）；他提出了'无待'这一超越所有条件依赖的自由理想；他开创了'物化'观念，消解主体与客体的本质界限。这些思维模式在现有78种模式中，M21已部分覆盖其顺应自然的一面，但庄子的贡献远超此范畴——他发展出了'认知解构'（M43）、'叙事认识论'（M44）、'主客消融'（M24）三个全新维度，构成中国思想史上独一无二的'诗性理性'传统。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M21(Cushlessness Governance), M24虚实转化(Reality-Illusion Transformation), M30(Cognitive Bias Recognition), M43 Qiwu Relativism (Equality of Things), M44 Fable Narrative Method. Zhuangzi's unique contribution: he was the first systematic user of 'fable-based thinking' as a philosophical method in Chinese history; he elevated relativism from epistemological tool to ontological revolution (Qiwu); he proposed 'wu dai' as a freedom ideal transcending all conditional dependence; he created the 'transformation of things' concept, dissolving the essential boundary between subject and object. In the existing 78 modes, M21 partially covers his 'following nature' aspect, but Zhuangzi's contribution far exceeds this — he developed three new dimensions: 'cognitive deconstruction' (M43), 'narrative epistemology' (M44), 'subject-object消融' (M24), forming a uniquely Chinese 'poetic rationality' tradition.
steps_zh: Step 1: 齐物解构——用「齐物相对法」(M43)识别一切对立范畴（是非、彼此、大小、生死）的人为建构性，通过'莫若以明'打破二元对立框架
Step 2: 破除成心——用「认知偏差识别法」(M30)觉察'成心'（prejudgment）如何遮蔽真实认知，以'吾丧我'实现认知主体的自我消解
Step 3: 虚实转化——用「虚实转化法」(M24)在'有待'与'无待'之间建立动态平衡，不执着于任何一方，如'庄周梦蝶'所示
Step 4: 寓言叙事——用「寓言叙事法」(M44)将抽象哲理转化为可体验的故事（鲲鹏、庖丁、濠梁、轮扁斫轮等），实现'得意忘言'
Step 5: 逍遥体证——用「无为而治法」(M21)的实践路径：无己→无功→无名，最终达到'乘天地之正，御六气之辩，以游无穷'的境界
steps_en: Step 1: Qiwu Deconstruction — Use 'Qiwu Relativism' (M43) to recognize the constructed nature of all oppositional categories (right/wrong, self/other, big/small, life/death), break dualistic frameworks through 'better to illuminate' (莫若以明)
Step 2: Break Prejudgment — Use 'Cognitive Bias Recognition' (M30) to觉察 how 'cheng xin' (成心/prejudgment) obscures genuine cognition, achieve cognitive subject dissolution through 'wu sang wo' (吾丧我)

Step 3: Reality-Illusion Transformation — Use 'Reality-Illusion Transformation' (M24) to establish dynamic balance between 'conditional' (有待) and 'unconditional' (无待), not clinging to either side, as shown in 'Zhuangzi's Butterfly Dream'

Step 4: Fable Narrative — Use 'Fable Narrative Method' (M44) to transform abstract philosophy into experiential stories (Great Peng, Cook Ding, Hao Liang, Wheelwright Bian), achieving 'grasping meaning, forgetting words' (得意忘言)

Step 5: Xiaoyao Embodiment — Use the practical path of 'Cushlessness Governance' (M21): no-self → no-achievement → no-name, ultimately reaching 'riding the correctness of Heaven and Earth, mastering the changes of the six breaths, wandering through the infinite' (乘天地之正，御六气之辩，以游无穷)

Established the ideal of 'wu dai' (unconditional freedom), providing transcendental spiritual resources for posterity
Pioneered 'fable narrative' philosophical method, achieving concretization of abstract philosophy
Developed 'transformation of things' theory, a cognitive revolution dissolving subject-object dualism
Constructed China's 'poetic rationality' tradition, influencing Xuanxue, Chan Buddhism, and literati spirituality for centuries
case_zh: 公元前4世纪战国中期，百家争鸣、名实之争激烈。庄子身处乱世，拒楚威王聘相，选择'曳尾涂中'的隐逸生活。其《庄子》内七篇构成完整思想体系：《逍遥游》以鲲鹏寓言开篇，通过'小大之辩'揭示认知局限，确立'无待'自由理想；《齐物论》以'南郭子綦隐机而坐'起，通过'吾丧我'境界，系统解构是非、彼此、生死的二元对立，提出'天地一指也，万物一马也'的齐物观；《养生主》以'庖丁解牛'寓言，展示'以无厚入有间'的顺应自然之道；《大宗师》以'物化'（庄周梦蝶）消解生死主客界限；《人间世》《德充符》《应帝王》则为齐物逍遥在社会伦理与政治层面的展开。其'寓言十九，重言十七，卮言日出'的叙事方法，使《庄子》成为中国文学与哲学史上最独特的文本。对后世：影响魏晋玄学（郭象注庄）、禅宗公案、李白杜甫苏轼等文人精神传统，乃至现代存在主义、解构主义均可在庄子找到先声。
case_en: Mid-Warring States period, 4th century BCE, when the Hundred Schools of Thought competed intensely and debates about names and realities were fierce. Zhuangzi, living in turbulent times, declined King Wei of Chu's offer to serve as chancellor, choosing the hermit's life of 'dragging his tail in the mud.' His 'Inner Chapters' of Zhuangzi form a complete philosophical system: 'Free and Easy Wandering' opens with the Great Peng fable, revealing cognitive limitations through the 'small vs. big debate' and establishing the ideal of 'unconditional freedom'; 'On the Equality of Things' begins with 'Nanguo Ziqi leaning on his staff,' through the 'I have lost my self' state, systematically deconstructs the dualistic opposition of right/wrong, self/other, life/death, proposing 'the world is one finger, all things are one horse' as the Qiwu view; 'The Way of养生主' presents through the 'Cook Ding carving an ox' fable the way of 'entering where there are gaps with nothing thick' — following nature; 'The Great Teacher' dissolves the boundary between life/death and subject/object through 'transformation of things' (Zhuangzi's Butterfly Dream); 'Being in the World,' 'Virtue Complete,' and 'Response of Emperors and Kings' then unfold Qiwu and Xiaoyao at the levels of social ethics and politics. His narrative method of 'nine-tenths fables, seven-tenths borrowed words, cup-words emerging daily' makes Zhuangzi the most unique text in Chinese literary and philosophical history. Its influence: Wei-Jin Xuanxue (Guo Xiang's commentary), Chan Buddhist gong'an, the spiritual traditions of poets like Li Bai, Du Fu, Su Shi, and even modern existentialism and deconstructionism can find their forerunners in Zhuangzi.
